# Nürnberg Renegades e.V.

> Nürnberg Renegades e.V. is a flag football club in Nürnberg, Germany, fielding two teams: the 1st team competes in the 1. DFFL (Germany's top division) and the 2nd team plays in the Bayernliga.

This file helps AI agents and language models understand the site structure and locate the club's official pages.

## Pages

- [Home](https://nuernberg-renegades.de/): Club overview, both teams, and how to join.
- [Team](https://nuernberg-renegades.de/team): Coaching staff and player roster.
- [Club](https://nuernberg-renegades.de/club): Club history, leadership, membership, and how to apply.
- [Training](https://nuernberg-renegades.de/training): Training times, locations, and tryouts.
- [Results](https://nuernberg-renegades.de/ergebnisse): Schedules and standings for both teams.
- [Sponsoring](https://nuernberg-renegades.de/sponsoring): Sponsorship information and current partners.
- [FAQ](https://nuernberg-renegades.de/faq): Frequently asked questions about membership, cost, and the club.
- [Contact](https://nuernberg-renegades.de/contact): Contact form and email address.

## Optional
